text:
Type: upholstered skirted footstool
Use: resting feet in front of a sofa or armchair, extra seating; living room, family room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: dark grey woven cotton-blend slipcover, pleated skirt, padded seat cushion, fabric side handle
Colors: dark charcoal grey
Shape: low rectangular box with a soft piped top cushion, box-pleated skirt to the floor, loop handle, rounded corners, low and bulky
Feel: cozy, relaxed, homey, soft
Goes with: grey or white slipcovered sofas, wood floors, linen and wool throws; traditional, farmhouse or classic living rooms

product.name: EKTORP
